lessons.title: Understanding Fractions
lessons.content: A fraction represents part of a whole. If a pizza has 8 slices and you eat 2, you ate two-eighths.
lessons.question: If you eat 4 of 8 slices, what fraction did you eat?

lessons.title: Reading Comprehension
lessons.content: Main idea means the most important point in a paragraph. Details explain and support that idea.
lessons.question: What does supporting detail do?

lessons.title: You Are Building Skill Every Day
lessons.caption: Progress is not always loud. Every small step is valid. Review one concept today and celebrate the effort.
lessons.transcript: Take one short lesson today, write one sentence about what you understood, and you have already moved forward.

lessons.title: Learning Is a Team Journey
lessons.caption: Ask for support early. Shared understanding grows faster than silent struggle. You belong in this learning space.
lessons.transcript: Find a peer, mentor, or teacher and send one question. Collaboration is a strength, not a weakness.

lessons.title: Consistency Beats Intensity
lessons.caption: Fifteen focused minutes every day can create powerful outcomes. Keep the rhythm and trust the process.
lessons.transcript: Set a small daily learning slot, repeat it, and reflect weekly. Your system matters more than one perfect day.
